episodes.title: ¡Todo el mundo al suelo!
episodes.summary: Three months after a failed coup d'état, armed men storm Barcelona's Central Bank, taking hundreds hostage. A young journalist is the first on the scene.

episodes.title: Off the record
episodes.summary: Maider defies Isabel's orders and butts heads with Berni. Number 1's plan hits a wall as conflicting theories about the attackers' identities emerge.

episodes.title: Tictac, tictac
episodes.summary: Isabel takes a risk and publishes Maider's hypothesis. Following a new lead, the police make headway and the Civil Guard presses for armed intervention.

episodes.title: El número 1
episodes.summary: As tensions reach boiling point inside the bank, Number 1's past comes to the fore. After raiding a suspect's home, Paco gives Maider a valuable tip.

episodes.title: La hora de la verdad
episodes.summary: The siege reaches a tense climax. As the government releases an official version of events, Maider fights to uncover the full truth, no matter the cost.
